title: Software Engineer
description: At Quest Analytics ®, we build technology that helps health plans navigate some of the most complex challenges in healthcare. We’re searching for a Software Engineer to help us build and scale our platform. You’ll own the features you build, from first requirements conversation through deployment, working alongside product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers. Your input on design and architecture will carry real weight, and the decisions you help make will shape our current offerings, and new product lines as we grow. Our engineering teams value high-quality code, open collaboration, and creative problem solving. We review each other’s work with constructive feedback, communicate early about blockers and risks, and take ownership of our results. We also embrace new technology, including AI-powered tools, to improve both the quality and the speed of what we deliver, and you’ll have a hand in shaping how our teams use them. What you'll do Take part in the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, and deployment. Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers to turn requirements into working software. Own your project timelines and deliverables, flag blockers and risks early so your team can help. Contribute to the design and architecture of new and existing products and features. Write clean, efficient, maintainable code built for performance and scalability. Give constructive feedback in code reviews and hold your work to team coding standards. Use AI-powered tools in your daily work to improve the quality and speed of development and help shape how the team adopts them. Make day-to-day technical decisions within established patterns, and bring larger choices, like major frameworks or design patterns, to your manager. Handle confidential information with care, especially protected health information (PHI), and follow Quest Analytics HIPAA Privacy and Security Practices. Join training and mentoring programs, as a learner or as a guide. What you'll need A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience. Three to five years of backend development with Microsoft’s .NET Framework and C# at a commercial SaaS company, ideally working with large data sets. Proficiency in SQL Server and in designing, building, and consuming REST APIs. Snowflake, Databricks, or general data platform experience for large data processing. Experience building on Azure cloud services, including Azure Functions, Event Grid, and Service Bus, plus familiarity with Blob Storage or AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SNS, or SQS. Experience with React or a comparable modern JavaScript framework for front-end work. Familiarity with unit testing (XUnit preferred) and SOLID principles. Source control experience with Git. Strong written and verbal communication, and a collaborative, team-oriented approach to your work. Experience multiplying your output with AI development tools. Compensation Additional Information About Quest Analytics For more than 20 years, we’ve been improving provider network management one groundbreaking innovation at a time. 90% of America’s health plans use our tools, including the eight largest in the nation. Achieve your personal quest to build a great career here. What you’ll appreciate: •Workplace flexibility – you choose between remote, hybrid or in-office •Affordable employee medical, dental and vision plans with low employee cost •401k Matching •Wellness benefits •Competitive salary and success sharing bonus •Flexible vacation, plus sick time and holidays •An entrepreneurial culture that won’t limit you to a job description •Being listened to, valued, appreciated -- and having your contributions rewarded •Enjoying your work each day with a great group of people Apply TODAY! careers.questanalytics.com Next Steps After you apply, you will receive an email confirming receipt of your application. If your background and experience align with our needs, a member of the Quest Analytics Talent Acquisition team will contact you regarding next steps in the process. Candidates will receive communication throughout the interview process regarding their status and progression. Interview Process The interview process may vary by role but typically includes: Recruiter Video Interview Video Interview with the Hiring Manager Team and/or Panel Interview(s) Role-Specific Assessment, Presentation, or Case Study (if applicable) Professional Reference Checks via Skill Survey Final Interview with Executive Leadership Video Camera Usage Policy Quest Analytics is a remote-first organization that values collaboration, communication, and engagement. To support a connected and productive work environment, candidates are expected to participate in all virtual interviews with their cameras enabled. Video participation helps create a more interactive interview experience, allows for stronger communication and relationship-building, and supports our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process. Camera usage also serves as an important safeguard against fraudulent applicants, identity misrepresentation, unauthorized participation, and other security risks that have become increasingly common in remote hiring environments. Candidates who are unable or unwilling to participate on camera during the interview process may not be considered for employment. Relocation Requirement While many positions at Quest Analytics are remote, employees are expected to reside in and perform work from the location disclosed during the hiring process. Any relocation must be communicated to and approved by Quest Analytics in advance. This policy helps ensure compliance with employment and tax regulations, protects company and client data, and reduces risks associated with unauthorized work arrangements and employment misrepresentation. A strong focus on testing An understanding of object oriented design and standard design patterns Strong experience of multi-threaded, 3-tier architectures, web services, caching, and dealing with event-driven pipelines Willingness to learn and use different technologies and programming languages First hand knowledge of Continuous Deployment tools and methodologies Experience working with public cloud. description: About Kaseya Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. Backed by Insight Partners , a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. Why Kaseya? Join a fast-growing company that’s transforming the IT industry. At Kaseya, you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, collaborate with a dynamic team, and develop your career in a high impact role. Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives! Job Summary We’re hiring Platform Backend Engineers to build and operate the core services connecting workflow execution, identity, event routing, secrets management, and audit capabilities across Kaseya’s platform. This is a hands-on backend role focused on Go or Rust, event-driven systems, multi-tenant security, and production reliability. You’ll build foundational services used by engineering teams and AI-enabled workflows, with correctness, auditability, and operational clarity as core design requirements. Roles & Responsibilities Build and operate core platform services, including API gateways, event routing, identity integrations, secrets management, and audit infrastructure Design event-driven systems that convert product events, alerts, and partner webhooks into durable workflow execution using Kafka and Temporal Implement a pluggable key-management layer supporting cloud KMS providers, bring-your-own-key models, envelope encryption, and per-client cryptographic isolation Build and enforce fine-grained capability grants for individual clients, workflows, operations, and service-to-service requests Own GitOps-based deployment pipelines for versioned workflow definitions across isolated client environments Develop onboarding automation for identity provisioning, compliance configuration, and client-specific key-management setup Build secure connector services for third-party APIs, including scoped access, platform-managed credentials, request validation, and audit logging Improve platform observability, reliability, failure recovery, security, and operational readiness while supporting production incident response Required Qualifications Experience building and operating production backend services using Go or Rust Experience designing event-driven systems using Kafka or similar technologies, including retries, idempotency, replay, and at-least-once delivery Experience implementing authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, or fine-grained access controls Experience implementing encryption or key-management solutions using cloud KMS platforms, envelope encryption, or key-hierarchy designs Experience operating multi-tenant production systems using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and incident-response practices Preferred Qualifications Experience with Temporal or another durable workflow orchestration platform Experience integrating identity platforms such as Zitadel, Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, or similar technologies Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar, append-only, or audit-focused data store Experience with GitOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code deployment practices Experience integrating MSP, PSA, RMM, security, or Microsoft 365 platform APIs Experience building software for regulated environments subject to SOC 2, HIPAA, CMMC, or similar requirements Experience developing multi-cloud platform services across AWS, Azure, or GCP Compensation Range The base salary range for this job is CAD $180,000 – $250,000 / year. An individual’s base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant. About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company that’s transforming the IT industry. At Kaseya, you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, collaborate with a dynamic team, and develop your career in a high impact role.

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We’re hiring Platform Backend Engineers to build and operate the core services connecting workflow execution, identity, event routing, secrets management, and audit capabilities across Kaseya’s platform. This is a hands-on backend role focused on Go or Rust, event-driven systems, multi-tenant security, and production reliability. You’ll build foundational services used by engineering teams and AI-enabled workflows, with correctness, auditability, and operational clarity as core design requirements.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Build and operate core platform services, including API gateways, event routing, identity integrations, secrets management, and audit infrastructure
  • Design event-driven systems that convert product events, alerts, and partner webhooks into durable workflow execution using Kafka and Temporal
  • Implement a pluggable key-management layer supporting cloud KMS providers, bring-your-own-key models, envelope encryption, and per-client cryptographic isolation
  • Build and enforce fine-grained capability grants for individual clients, workflows, operations, and service-to-service requests
  • Own GitOps-based deployment pipelines for versioned workflow definitions across isolated client environments
  • Develop onboarding automation for identity provisioning, compliance configuration, and client-specific key-management setup
  • Build secure connector services for third-party APIs, including scoped access, platform-managed credentials, request validation, and audit logging
  • Improve platform observability, reliability, failure recovery, security, and operational readiness while supporting production incident response

Required Qualifications

  • Experience building and operating production backend services using Go or Rust
  • Experience designing event-driven systems using Kafka or similar technologies, including retries, idempotency, replay, and at-least-once delivery
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, or fine-grained access controls
  • Experience implementing encryption or key-management solutions using cloud KMS platforms, envelope encryption, or key-hierarchy designs
  • Experience operating multi-tenant production systems using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and incident-response practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Temporal or another durable workflow orchestration platform
  • Experience integrating identity platforms such as Zitadel, Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, or similar technologies
  • Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar, append-only, or audit-focused data store
  • Experience with GitOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code deployment practices
  • Experience integrating MSP, PSA, RMM, security, or Microsoft 365 platform APIs
  • Experience building software for regulated environments subject to SOC 2, HIPAA, CMMC, or similar requirements
  • Experience developing multi-cloud platform services across AWS, Azure, or GCP

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is CAD $180,000 – $250,000 / year.

An individual’s base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant. At Kaseya, certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role.

description: About Pair Team Pair Team is building a new kind of healthcare system across Medicaid, Medicare, and public assistance programs: one that recognizes that access to housing, nutritious food, and reliable transportation are just as critical to health as having the right medications or seeing a doctor. We are currently the largest complex care provider in California with over 500 employees and are expanding nationally. Our model replaces fragmented healthcare and social services systems with one trusted relationship for all medical, behavioral, and social needs. We improve access, build trust, and dramatically lower costs (52% fewer ER visits, 26% fewer hospitalizations). Our model is a rare combination of saving tax payer dollars ($150B annually at scale) while putting people on an upward life trajectory. At national scale, this approach would save taxpayers. These outcomes are driven by the AI-first, whole-person infrastructure we are building — a platform that connects healthcare and social-service organizations into a unified network. Leveraging our vast data and years of operational experience, we are building the agentic infrastructure for the safety net to coordinate care, automate operations, and learn from every patient interaction to continuously improve outcomes. Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered or agentic systems in production, not just prototypes. Experience in healthcare, health tech, or other regulated domains (HIPAA, PHI handling, clinical workflows). Deep familiarity with agent architecture patterns: planning and reasoning, tool use and orchestration, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop design. Experience designing evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic systems, including offline evals, regression testing, and production monitoring. Strong grounding in safety, guardrails, and reliability for AI systems operating in high-stakes or regulated environments. Familiarity with voice or multimodal agents. Ability to set technical strategy and translate it into a roadmap, with a record of influencing leadership and cross-functional partners (product, clinical, operations). Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences. Strong desire to work in an early stage startup environment that is fast paced and complex Passion for helping individuals experiencing complex chronic needs such as homelessness, severe mental illness, and substance use disorder Strong preference for candidates with proficiency in Ruby on Rails, Langfuse, Mastra, and/or Livekit; plus distributed systems and backend fundamentals (APIs, data pipelines, observability, cloud infrastructure). title: Mobile Engineer
description: About Fin Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin. About the Role We are looking for a Mobile Engineer to own our mobile experience across iOS and Android using React Native. This will be the first time many users interact with Fin, so your work will define how our product feels in the real world. You will turn messy real world payment flows into simple, intuitive interfaces, and help hide the complexity of crypto, wallets, and cross border settlement behind a smooth mobile experience. You will work closely with the founders and the rest of the engineering team, make foundational decisions about architecture and design, and ship features from idea to production. If you care about building delightful consumer products on top of serious infrastructure, this is for you. We value your time: our process focuses on practical system design and architectural discussions, not LeetCode grinding or unpaid take-home assignments. Responsibilities Own the Fin mobile app across iOS and Android using React Native, from architecture to implementation and polish. Design and implement flows that make sending, receiving, and managing money feel simple and trustworthy for everyday users. Help design secure account and custody patterns that can scale to handle meaningful balances and real world usage. Collaborate with design and product to prototype, refine, and ship new features quickly. Maintain a high bar for code quality through thoughtful architecture, code review, and testing. Work with backend and infra engineers to integrate APIs, payments, and identity or security features into the mobile app. Qualifications 3+ years of experience building and shipping mobile apps in React Native . Deep familiarity with the Expo ecosystem and modern mobile build pipelines (EAS) is required. Strong product sense and attention to detail in UI and UX, especially for consumer facing apps. Solid understanding of mobile app architecture, performance, and offline or edge cases. Ability to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects from idea to shipped. Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating with design, product, and backend teams. Interest in payments, fintech, or crypto. You do not need to be a chain maximalist, but curiosity about the space helps. Bonus Points You have shipped an app from concept to production in a small team or as the primary developer. Experience in EITHER traditional consumer fintech apps (neobanks, peer-to-peer payments) OR mobile crypto wallets (Solana, non-custodial, etc). Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS. Experience deploying smart contracts on Solana or integrating with blockchain based systems. Background in security, threat modeling, or penetration testing, especially for consumer finance products.

title: Software Engineer
description: Who we are At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer . About the job This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.= The successful candidate will design, build, and operate core billing platform services that help transition our platform and our customers to the next generation architecture. These services work for all Twilio customers, regardless of their scale and billing complexity. The ideal candidate will build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software that complies with high levels of coding standards and technical design. This is to build and integrate services that continuously improve our ability to provide products to customers while simultaneously delivering industry leading availability. We do this by leveraging technologies that include AWS cloud infrastructure and APIs, Apache Kafka, Rest APIs (OpenAPI compliance), while also building our own services. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Improve your knowledge of highly available and scalable distributed systems and use this knowledge to build new features into our platform. Design, implement, and operate both new features on our current services as well as new services that will be built from scratch. Leverage your excellent communication and written skills to articulate the "why" of the solution you are proposing, and have a good understanding of your team’s priorities and the customer impact. Troubleshoot and fix operational issues and have the opportunity to improve the troubleshooting procedures and tools. Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC). Develop flowcharts and documentation to identify solutions. Write well-designed, testable code. Document and maintain software functionality. Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! *Required: 0-2 years of work experience building highly scalable products. Experience of programming in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices. Knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record. Experience with relational and non-relational databases. Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged. Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion. Clear written and spoken communication skills. Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Desired: Familiarity in Cloud Solutions, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD pipelines, Testing & Automation. Experience delivering high levels of observability and proficiency in improving early warning systems, for example: has worked with Grafana/DataDog/Prometheus. Experience with on-call support for mission-critical customer systems. Experience optimizing and debugging SQL queries. Experience working on customer-facing applications. Good debugging skills on production systems. Proficient in Linux and containerization with Kubernetes. Nice to have skills: gRPC, Python, Typescript, React, Apache Kafka. Location This role will be remote, and based in Ireland. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. . Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. raw.jobDescription:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer.

About the job

This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.=

The successful candidate will design, build, and operate core billing platform services that help transition our platform and our customers to the next generation architecture. These services work for all Twilio customers, regardless of their scale and billing complexity.

The ideal candidate will build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software that complies with high levels of coding standards and technical design. This is to build and integrate services that continuously improve our ability to provide products to customers while simultaneously delivering industry leading availability. We do this by leveraging technologies that include AWS cloud infrastructure and APIs, Apache Kafka, Rest APIs (OpenAPI compliance), while also building our own services.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Improve your knowledge of highly available and scalable distributed systems and use this knowledge to build new features into our platform.
  • Design, implement, and operate both new features on our current services as well as new services that will be built from scratch.
  • Leverage your excellent communication and written skills to articulate the "why" of the solution you are proposing, and have a good understanding of your team’s priorities and the customer impact.
  • Troubleshoot and fix operational issues and have the opportunity to improve the troubleshooting procedures and tools.
  • Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC).
  • Develop flowcharts and documentation to identify solutions.
  • Write well-designed, testable code.
  • Document and maintain software functionality.
  • Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 0-2 years of work experience building highly scalable products.
  • Experience of programming in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices.
  • Knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases.
  • Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged.
  • Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion.
  • Clear written and spoken communication skills.
  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Desired:

  • Familiarity in Cloud Solutions, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD pipelines, Testing & Automation.
  • Experience delivering high levels of observability and proficiency in improving early warning systems, for example: has worked with Grafana/DataDog/Prometheus.
  • Experience with on-call support for mission-critical customer systems.
  • Experience optimizing and debugging SQL queries.
  • Experience working on customer-facing applications.
  • Good debugging skills on production systems.
  • Proficient in Linux and containerization with Kubernetes.
  • Nice to have skills: gRPC, Python, Typescript, React, Apache Kafka.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Germany | Remote
description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend The Opportunity: Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem. As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana. You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise. AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability. Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs. Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities. Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands. Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk. Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through. Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work. Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities. Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need. Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work. Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes. Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions. What Makes You a Great Fit Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly. A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers. A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands. Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes. Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation. An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams. Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. Bonus Points For Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems. Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions. Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products. Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations. Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product. Compensation & Rewards: In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 124,571 - EUR 149,485. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring technical engineering manager to redefine the embedded Linux experience with the smallest, most secure, and most reliable operating system in the IoT market.

This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill as well as high caliber for inspiring and driving people.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardize the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an engineering manager, you’ll lead a team of strong software developers to design and implement Ubuntu Core system software on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will meet stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan the roadmap and ensure the team can deliver their goals. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The role entails

  • Effectively setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocating and advancing modern, agile software development practices and helping develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Contributing to a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Actively participating in the leadership team and collaborating with other leaders in the organisation

  • Demonstrated competencies in embedded software development
  • Strong skills in Golang, C++ and Shell
  • A solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Love for developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • Demonstrated ability of planning and executing to deliver high quality software in a timely manner
  • Solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Nice-to-have skills

  • Familiarity with an immutable Linux distribution, preferably Ubuntu Core
  • Experience with multiple CPU architectures such as ARM, RISC-V
  • Experience with Linux native containerization and security

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals.   • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave

  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.jobDescription:
Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. We're always looking for thoughtful, driven Engineering Managers to add to our org. Some of our teams are building customer-facing product and workflows; others keep our distributed systems reliable, observable, and ready to scale. Whichever kind of problem energizes you, if you lead people well, hold a high technical bar, and drive work to completion without waiting to be handed a plan, we want to hear from you.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies—from scrappy startups to global brands—use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data—what people do or don't do inside a web or mobile app. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What we value

Ownership. You set direction and see initiatives through. You create clarity when things are murky and set the path forward rather than waiting for one to be defined, and you're motivated by impact—not just intention. You hold yourself and your team accountable to shipping, not just staying busy.

Leaders who can do both. You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align stakeholders on a plan and earn your engineers' respect in the same day—you don't choose between vision and execution, you hold both.

A drive to execute through resistance. Competing priorities, skeptical stakeholders, tired teams—you've moved work forward anyway. You name the resistance, make the call, and own the milestones and the misses.

An AI-first mindset. AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You have a real, concrete point of view on AI-native development, you use agentic tooling yourself, and you bring it into how your squad operates.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done." You bring rigor and pragmatism. Best practices matter—but never more than forward motion. You know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait—and you're comfortable making the call with incomplete information, then adjusting as you learn.

What you'll do

  • Care deeply about our customers and their outcomes
  • Lead your squad to deliver real customer value by owning projects end to end—from planning through delivery, quality, and follow-through
  • Drive execution: set milestones, keep work moving through ambiguity and competing priorities, and ship in small, observable increments rather than waiting for a release window
  • Make confident decisions when the path isn't obvious, and lead your team through them
  • Set the operating rhythm that helps your team move fastest, rather than defaulting to ceremony for its own sake
  • Ensure your squad's solutions are scalable, architecturally sound, flexible, and secure, with strong peer-review, QA, documentation, deployment, logging, and monitoring practices
  • Stay close to the work—jump into design reviews, architecture calls, and incidents rather than watching from a distance
  • Provide direct, timely, and specific coaching, and create meaningful development opportunities for your direct reports
  • Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build
  • Hire, onboard, and manage performance so the right people are in place to hit your squad's goals
  • Bring an AI-native perspective—use AI tools to accelerate the team's velocity and help everyone prototype faster and ship smarter
  • Partner across engineering and other departments to align efforts with customer success, and reach higher when our customers are having a bad day

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years managing engineers at a SaaS company (B2B or B2C), ideally early-to-mid-stage
  • A track record of driving execution—concrete delivery outcomes with milestones, dates, and "I drove" ownership, especially in complex or fast-moving environments
  • A strong technical background—you can hold your own in architecture conversations and design reviews, represent your squad's technical choices across the company, and you've shipped real work recently enough to stay credible
  • Comfort operating with high autonomy and little prescribed structure—you create your own clarity and make difficult tradeoffs between competing priorities
  • Demonstrated AI-native leadership—not just personal fluency, but bringing AI-first practices into how your team builds
  • Experience building high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative teams
  • Clear, concise, and direct communication, both verbal and written

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $185,000-$215,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. Application - We review everyone with care.
  2. Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for, your leadership style, and how we work.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Deep dive into your experience leading teams, your technical philosophy, and how you think about building organizations.
  4. People Partner Interview (30 mins) - Explore your leadership style, management philosophy, and approach to supporting high-performing teams with our engineering people partner.
  5. Technical Interview (60 mins) - Engage in a collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges.
  6. Take-Home Assignment - Submit a short written retrospective on a project you’ve led as an Engineering Manager.
  7. Retrospective Review Call (60 mins) - We’ll use your written submission as the foundation for a deeper conversation.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

environments, advocate for tight collaboration between engineering, user experience, and product teams, and are comfortable making engineering and system-level decisions and tradeoffs Proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including React and Node.js Experienced with relational, NoSQL, and document/object storage Proven record of solving deep problems in distributed systems and real-time data technologies Built and operated secure, compliant, scalable systems behind high-impact user experiences Led large projects across multiple teams and mentored both junior and senior engineers raw.jobDescription:
About the Team

At AudioEye, we believe access to digital content is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Our mission is clear: eliminate every barrier to digital accessibility so that everyone, regardless of ability, can experience the web without limitations.

We are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are driven by purpose and impact. Every challenge we tackle moves us closer to a future where creating accessible experiences is the standard. If you’re looking for meaningful work where you can drive real change, influence how people with disabilities experience the internet, and be part of a mission that matters, AudioEye is the place for you.

About the Role

The Staff Engineer role helps to drive the technical direction of AudioEye’s platform and tackles complex challenges in digital accessibility. The position is responsible for designing and building large-scale, reliable systems that detect, remediate, and prevent accessibility issues across millions of websites, using AI and agentic development as a core part of how the work gets done. It blends architecture, hands-on development, and technical leadership to ensure systems are secure, scalable, and performant.

This role collaborates closely with the Product and Design teams to deliver systems that create measurable impact for customers and end users. The Staff Engineer mentors junior engineers on the team, helps shape the technical roadmap, and makes decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term sustainability. It requires strong ownership, autonomy, and a focus on solving meaningful technical problems at scale.

How you’ll Contribute:

  • Technically lead one or more engineering teams through needs assessment, system design, implementation, and operations automation
  • Drive the technical roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with long-term sustainability
  • Partner with Product, Design, and engineers to build systems that help customers respond quickly to risk, while keeping reliability, security, and data consistency high
  • Build web-scale systems with strong grounding in service-oriented architecture, data modeling, performance, and end-to-end delivery
  • Understand customer and end-user needs and turn them into measurable value
  • Own problems across stacks, teams, and roles, with a bias for action
  • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily to design, build, test, and operate software without lowering the quality bar. Delegate to agents, then review, verify, and take accountability for the output
  • Evaluate new AI development tools and adopt those that measurably improve delivery
  • Mentor and coach engineers on requirements, system design, problem-solving, and practical AI-assisted development, including prompting, context management, and knowing when not to trust the output
  • Help define team standards for responsible AI use across code review, testing, security, and data handling
  • Find opportunities to build AI capabilities into our products and internal tooling
  • Build a culture of quality, high standards, and engineering excellence

Who you are:

  • 10+ years of engineering experience with design, implementation, and operations of critical systems
  • Demonstrated success working in cross-functional environments, advocate for tight collaboration between engineering, user experience, and product teams, and are comfortable making engineering and system-level decisions and tradeoffs
  • Proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, including React and Node.js
  • Experienced with relational, NoSQL, and document/object storage
  • Proven record of solving deep problems in distributed systems and real-time data technologies
  • Built and operated secure, compliant, scalable systems behind high-impact user experiences
  • Led large projects across multiple teams and mentored both junior and senior engineers
  • Collaborate tightly with Product and UX, and are comfortable making system-level tradeoffs
  • Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development, with concrete examples of how it changed how you build and ship
  • Sound judgment on where AI helps and where it adds risk, and the discipline to validate generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability
  • Have coached other engineers, including senior ones, to adopt AI-assisted workflows
  • Thrive on autonomy and ownership, and adapt quickly as tools and practices change
  • Model good engineering behavior, practices, and processes

Our Values:

  • Relentlessly Prioritize the Customer
  • Own Outcomes
  • Be Straightforward
  • Act Now & Iterate
  • Grit
  • Decide with Data
  • Hire and Develop A Players
  • Be Coachable
  • Organize and Plan
  • Expect and Embrace Change

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work with a talented but humble team
  • Competitive compensation and equity
  • Weekly paid family meal
  • 401k, medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO Policy
  • 15.5 company-paid holidays including Juneteenth, MLK Day and a 1-week company shut down
  • To support remote work conditions, AudioEye provides each employee a one-time stipend of $300

title: Staff Engineer, Full Stack (Trust, Safety & Risk)
description: Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide. Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone. We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm. Responsibilities As a Trust, Risk & Safety Engineer at Phantom, you’ll build the systems that safeguard our users, products, and platform. Working across the stack, you’ll detect and prevent abuse, assess emerging risks, reduce financial loss, and equip internal teams with the tools and intelligence needed to respond quickly and effectively. The ideal candidate brings high agency, a strong sense of ownership, exceptional technical judgment and product taste, a relentless work ethic, and the emotional intelligence to navigate complex, high-stakes situations. Fraud prevention: Build real-time risk controls and decisioning systems for products such as ACH, debit cards, onramps, off-ramps, and other money movement experiences. Scam and abuse detection: Develop signals, models, and product interventions that identify malicious wallets, transactions, applications, and user behavior. Identity and compliance infrastructure: Build scalable KYC, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, case management, and audit systems. Data and intelligence: Create pipelines and tools that combine on-chain activity, product data, and third-party signals into actionable risk insights. Product safety: Partner with product and engineering teams to design safeguards into new features from the beginning without compromising the user experience. Operational tooling: Build internal tools that help Risk, Compliance, Support, and Security teams investigate incidents and take action efficiently. Team building: Help establish the technical foundations and engineering culture for a new, high-impact function at Phantom. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience 8+ years of full-time software engineering experience Experience designing and operating reliable, data-intensive production systems Strong product judgment and the ability to balance user experience, financial risk, and operational complexity Ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, data pipelines, and third-party integrations Demonstrated interest in protecting users and building trustworthy financial products Nice to have: Experience with fraud, risk, identity, KYC, AML, sanctions, payments, fintech, or blockchain systems English language proficiency Why Work with Us First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem. Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do. We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users. Benefits Competitive salary and equity Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) — 100% covered Stipend for your ideal remote set-up Flexible hours and a supportive remote environment Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!) 401(k) retirement plan Monthly wellness benefit Weekly meal benefit Global off-sites The target base salary for this role will range between $200,000 to $250,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors (such as location) at the point in time of offer. We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career. By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
